deviations.what: The original registers an app-authored addValidator callback. abap2UI5 does ship a validator - the bundled companion control z2ui5.cc.MultiInputExt installs addValidator(({text}) => new Token({key:text, text})) and mirrors added/removed tokens back through addedTokens/removedTokens (CAPABILITIES.md marks it fine, and apps 040/612/613 use it). What it cannot do is run THIS sample's per-field logic, which is what is improvised here: the bundled validator is fixed, so the port rebuilds the accept/reject decision in ABAP over a change round-trip instead.

The three MultiInputs get a bound tokens aggregation with a Token template each (structural-diff reports control extra Token: 0 vs 3) - the original creates its Tokens in JavaScript, so its view declares none.

All three token-creation paths, including the confirm round-trip of the second field, are unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-08-25** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_501.mjs).
